0022600130.text: The San Antonio Spurs (1-2, 0-2 at home) host the Sacramento Kings (0-2) in the fourth game of the Spurs' season, with San Antonio currently 10th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest, while Sacramento is 14th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Pacific. The Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and the Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Spurs won all three games against Sacramento in 2025-26, including a 132-104 win in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
